points.description: Control plane responsibility: decides/computes routes or manages the network (logically centralized), sets up/updates flow tables of switches, or handles packets the switches cannot process.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely described as 'the control/brain of the network' without a responsibility.

points.description: Data plane responsibility: forwards packets, with switches executing actions per their flow tables set by the control plane.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it 'handles traffic' or 'the switches' without forwarding.

points.description: Names two tasks of the SDN controller, e.g. configuring forwarding/flow tables, handling packet-in events, injecting packets, monitoring traffic statistics, topology discovery, device inventory, northbound/southbound interfaces, implementing the control plane.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one valid task is named.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the control plane role, the data plane role, and two controller tasks, in any wording. Give part marks for vague but on-track statements or only one controller task. Wrong extra remarks cost nothing unless they swap the roles of the planes.
